description: Before LM5-common-18 freezing, investigators had seen a MOVER proxy event rate of approximately 11%-13% and a high-coverage proxy cohort of 16527 cases with 1887 events.
impact: The study is outcome-summary aware and cannot claim complete outcome blinding; no LM5-common patient-level MOVER predictions, calibration, AUPRC, Brier, DCA, or threshold optimization were used for model development.
mitigation: Freeze the full INSPIRE model and all analysis rules before the one-time MOVER U0 run; disclose this as Amber independence.

description: The local EPIC_patient_measurments.tar.gz download is incomplete (about 8.0 GB versus expected about 17.8 GB).
impact: Using it would create unknown case and time-series truncation.
mitigation: Permanently exclude it from this project; use the complete Epic_flowsheets_cleaned.tar.gz source.

description: INSPIRE documentation confirms median aggregation to at most 5-min resolution but does not publish bin origin, boundary convention, timestamp placement, or ART/NIBP fusion.
impact: MOVER H5 cannot be claimed to exactly reproduce the undisclosed INSPIRE publisher algorithm.
mitigation: Call H5 a prespecified harmonisation operator and report phase, boundary, statistic, and source-priority sensitivities.

description: The public INSPIRE operation times are relative to each admission rather than a shared cross-patient calendar; opdate is dominated by postoperative day values and cannot identify calendar chronology.
impact: A genuine chronological 70/30 patient split cannot be implemented without falsely labelling admission-relative time as calendar time.
mitigation: Replace the planned temporal holdout with a reproducible 70/30 patient-level holdout stratified by outcome, retain patient-grouped five-fold CV, and rely on MOVER as the independent external validation.

description: The first freeze manifest contained fitted objects and test vectors but not a project-relative primary code hash list.
impact: The bundle needed an explicit executable-code lineage file before MOVER prediction.
mitigation: Before any MOVER probability or performance was generated, add code_SHA256SUMS.csv and freeze version 1.0.1; assert model.json, preprocess.json, thresholds.json and test_vectors.csv hashes are unchanged and rerun the 1e-12 test-vector gate.

description: Independent pre-U0 audit found that the originally selected ridge lambda 0.001 was the lower boundary of the prespecified grid; an INSPIRE-only extension showed a slightly lower grouped-CV log loss at 0.00001.
impact: The original grid did not demonstrate that the ridge optimum was bracketed, although the absolute log-loss difference was small.
mitigation: Before any MOVER probability or performance, expand the INSPIRE-only lambda grid to 0 through 100 including 1e-6, 1e-5 and 1e-4; rerun internal evaluation, final refit, thresholds, test vectors, precision plan and all hashes as freeze v1.1.0.

description: Independent pre-U0 audit found that the preliminary net-benefit precision width used only between-risk variation and omitted conditional Bernoulli outcome variance.
impact: The preliminary width 0.003397 was too narrow; the corrected planning width is expected near 0.0138, while the calibration-slope sample-size target remains unchanged.
mitigation: Use total variance = E[Var(Z|p)] + Var(E[Z|p]) for the fixed-threshold net-benefit contribution, regenerate the precision table, and retain n=6152 as the maximum formal target if unchanged.

description: Independent pre-U0 code review identified race conditions, incomplete input binding and non-atomic result writes in the preliminary one-time MOVER validation runner; no MOVER prediction or performance had been generated.
impact: A technical interruption or concurrent launch could otherwise create duplicate or partially committed U0 results and weaken proof that the validated inputs matched the pre-model QA and frozen bundle.
mitigation: Before U0, require an external pre-U0 freeze receipt, atomically create the execution lock, bind every cohort/config/code input by SHA-256, verify hashes again after computation, stage all outputs outside the final directory and atomically commit only a complete successful attempt; permit only exact-hash technical recovery.
